description: Send a follow-up message in a completed task's conversation, as a new queued task. Use when: the user follows up on a finished task's result. Do not use for a failed task (use retry_task) or for an unrelated new task (use schedule_task). Behavior: each call adds one task to the local queue with earlier turns as history, the same provider and model, and its own clean window; no login now; it runs later as one provider call with the original's credentials. Returns: task_id, parent_task_id, status, scheduled_for, deadline. Rejects non-completed and unknown tasks and text over 32000 characters.

deadline.description: When the reply must be finished, ISO-8601 with offset, e.g. '2026-05-12T20:00:00Z'. Defaults to one hour from now.

task_id.description: Id of the completed task to continue, e.g. 't-3f2a…', from the check_queue_status list (status completed).

text.description: The user's follow-up, sent as the next turn after the task's earlier reply, e.g. 'Now cut it to 3 bullets'. Up to 32000 characters.

name: reply_task
